sn22.121:1.2: upādāniye ca bhikkhave, dhamme desissāmi upādānañca,
sn22.121:1.4: katame ca bhikkhave, upādāniyā dhammā, katamaṃ upādānaṃ:
sn22.121:1.6: yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha upādānaṃ.
sn22.121:1.7: vedanā upādāniyo dhammo, yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha upādānaṃ.
sn22.121:1.11: yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha upādānaṃ.
sn22.121:1.12: ime vuccanti bhikkhave, upādāniyā dhammā, idaṃ upādānanti.
